Hi there! 👋 Thanks so much for reaching out to Leafy!

Based on your location, you're in **Zone 3** (over 1,000 miles from our nearest greenhouse). Here's what you can expect:

**Standard Shipping:** 5–8 business days
- Cost: $7.95 (free on orders $75+)

**Express Shipping:** Unfortunately, Express isn't available for Zone 3 addresses.

**One more thing to know:** Live plants ship Monday–Wednesday only. So if you order after noon on Wednesday, your order will ship the following Monday. Non-living items (pots, soil, etc.) ship Monday–Friday, but if you mix them with plants, everything ships together on a plant day.

Is there anything else I can help you with? Happy to answer any other questions! 🌱
